final: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_games, 1.0 * total_games / SUM(total_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_all_games, 1.0 * total_games / AVG(total_games) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM team_totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
